title: Cloud Security: negotiated prices
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for negotiated prices.

## Basis

Negotiated-rate override permission: Whether an approved signed unit-rate amendment overrides the standard primary rate; boolean.

Primary-price selection priority: Non-stacking selection order for primary-usage price; string list.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Negotiated-rate override permission | Primary-price selection priority |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | Yes | negotiated, reservation, promotion, portfolio, standard |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | Yes | negotiated, reservation, promotion, portfolio, standard |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | Yes | negotiated, reservation, promotion, portfolio, standard |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | Yes | negotiated, reservation, promotion, portfolio, standard |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | Yes | negotiated, reservation, promotion, portfolio, standard |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | Yes | negotiated, reservation, promotion, portfolio, standard |

## Tier comparison

The listed negotiated prices bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
